notes.title: Update to version 0.1.2
notes.notes:
Fixed the bug of inaccurate mouse coordinates, the mouse should be able to click correctly when the screen is zoomed in and out

Added the Three Fairies of Light, placed on the second floor of the Fairy Giant Tree in the Enchanted Forest, which also allows you to bring them out during quick battles
Sunny Milk: 
    Sunny is an explosive fighter that can deal a lot of damage in a short period of time, and she has the following skills:
[olist]
         Sonny's Windmill: Sonny jumps into the air and spins his weapon while approaching the enemy, the spinning weapon will continue to deal damage. This move can be interrupted by a powerful attack or a wall, and once interrupted, Sonny will go straight for a while!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44963046/e7eb7f00fcf2dd088fd5c82c4b182a6c73edcd9b.gif
         Sunny Counterattack: this is a defensive skill, when Sunny detects that he is going to be attacked, he will probability quickly sprint in the direction of the attack while spinning his weapon to attack, this skill has no foreshock and can be interrupted by an attack or a wall as well
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44963046/d57384bf93f662873b0312341ad327650af79764.gif
         Direct Sun Shot: when far away from Sunny, Sunny will probability shoot a fan-shaped laser at the target, which is Sunny's long-range attack means
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44963046/9b77be82c1ea22ff205f168864e1005f73e3d080.gif
[/olist]
Luna Child:
    Luna is also a warrior, but her DPS isn't as high as Sunny's, and she has some high mobility and support skills:
[olist]
         Spinning Jump: Luna jumps up holding her weapon and spins around to attack, this skill can be interrupted by an attack or a wall, after the skill is interrupted, Luna will be hard for a while
         Luna Sends Wink: Luna fires a huge chestnut at the enemy, which penetrates the enemy, this is Luna's long range attack
         Flat Earth Fall: Luna will probabilistically fall, and then make everyone who sees her fall probabilistically fall as well, regardless of friend or foe
[/olist]
    Luna's scythe has a special battle technique: when the technique is activated, Luna will sprint in the direction of the attack while wielding her scythe, dealing damage!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44963046/c14fa9caa21092dae3b3473309dbc2cfc234da1d.gif
Starr Sapphire:
    Starr is a long-range mage who fires star bullets that can split, and she has the following skills:
[olist]
         Meteor Shower: Summons a large number of star bullets in the attack position for a frame drop attack. This skill basically can't hit anyone
         Comet Jump: when Starr realizes he's going to be hit, he'll probability teleport, instantly moving to a nearby location
[/olist]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44963046/1b8cd620fb6a8985c825c006cb833419ced4f13e.gif
The Three Fairies of Light will call out to each other in battle, and the player will face the attacks of all three at the same time!

Also updated the Fairy Queen's location, moving it from the Fairy Queen's Visitation Hall to the second floor of the Enchanted Forest.
